note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1961: nominations 16 May 1961; nine contests, polled 1 June 1961 and counted 2 June by W. B. O'Donoghue, returning officer. No party labels printed. Returned unopposed. P. D. Fearon: no party label printed in 1961. At other elections he stood as Nationalist (Killeavy, Armagh County Council, 5 June 1958, printed 'N.': Armagh Guardian, 23 May 1958, p. 4 ("Local Council Elections: No Contests for County Council")).
